text:
If you follow more people than follow you, you just announced you're low status.

Your follower ratio is a scoreboard.

You follow more than follow you back? You're announcing: I chase, I hand out free attention, I'm trying too hard.

High status men control their attention. Every unreciprocated follow is currency you gave away.

Unfollow anyone who doesn't follow back. Aim minimum 1:1, ideally way more followers than follows.

Your ratio is your reputation.
caption:
Your ratio is your status. Discipline means controlling your attention like currency. Start with who you follow.

Send this to a man who needs it today.
